T:P1.1.text: Specialized Care for Women, Babies and Children | Pediatrix & Obstetrix

T:P1.2.text: Led by physicians and trusted by patients, Pediatrix delivers advanced medical solutions across a variety of practice areas around the country.

T:P1.5.text: Be part of a nationwide team of physicians, advanced practitioners, and operational experts all working to support families and advance patient care.

T:P1.6.text: We are one of the nation's largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services.

T:P1.7.text: We operate in 37 states, partner with nearly 400 hospitals, and work with 4,300+ affiliated clinicians.

T:P1.8.text: We bring more than 45 years of experience to help hospitals respond to shifting demands with flexible, patient-centered care strategies.

T:P1.9.text: We invest in clinical services, operations, technology, and education—giving our clinicians the tools, resources, and support they need to deliver exceptional patient care.

C:P1.1.text: The Ensign Group, Inc. – Skilled Nursing, Rehabilitation Therapy, Healthcare – San Juan Capistrano, CA

C:P1.2.text: Ensign’s independent operating affiliates provide personalized post-acute and long-term care services guided by local leadership and delivered by clinicians committed to helping residents heal, regain independence, and thrive.

C:P1.3.text: Commitment to quality Find care near you

C:P1.4.text: At the heart of our organization are hundreds of dedicated affiliates who enrich the lives of thousands of residents each year through exceptional care and genuine human connection.

C:P1.5.text: Through Moments of Truth, we will dignify post-acute care in the eyes of the world.

C:P1.6.text: Ensign Affiliates Provide Care That Counts

C:P1.8.text: Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services through a unique ONE CLINICAL approach.

C:P1.9.text: This collaborative model brings an interdisciplinary team together at each location to deliver individualized, resident-centered care. By combining clinical excellence, exceptional service, and data-driven decision-making, the ONE CLINICAL teams help residents achieve better outcomes and live life to the fullest.

C:P2.1.text: Care Services – The Ensign Group, Inc.

C:P2.2.text: Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services that leverage a ONE CLINICAL collaborative model of care focused on enhancing the lives of those they serve.

C:P2.4.text: At Ensign-affiliated locations, exceptional care begins with collaboration. Through a ONE CLINICAL approach, nurses, therapists, physicians, and interdisciplinary care teams work together to provide coordinated, personalized care that supports each resident’s unique needs. This collaborative model helps each resident benefit from a seamless, individualized care experience designed to maximize that individual resident’s health and wellness.

C:P2.5.text: Care Designed Around the Whole Person

C:P2.6.text: Rather than treating individual conditions in isolation, Ensign-affiliated teams take a comprehensive view of residents’ health. By combining clinical expertise, compassionate caregiving, and evidence-based practices, residents obtain the support they need to recover from illness, regain function, maintain independence, and achieve their highest possible quality of life.

C:P2.7.text: Driven by Data. Focused on Outcomes.

C:P2.8.text: The ONE CLINICAL approach is guided by clinical data and continuous improvement principles. Care teams monitor key quality measures and resident outcomes to identify risks early, evaluate progress, and develop targeted interventions that support better health and recovery. This commitment to measurement and accountability helps drive stronger outcomes while supporting overall quality of care and promoting regulatory excellence.

C:P3.2.text: Our affiliated locations are led by local teams who independently make decisions and create exceptional experiences for those they serve.
